listing.description_html:
Plan the week's shifts, see each person's hours and overtime, and check the week's labor cost as a share of forecast sales before the schedule goes out.

This workbook turns a weekly schedule into money: hours per person per day, regular and overtime hours, the cost of each person with employer taxes, the daily hours on the floor, and the week's labor cost as a share of the sales you forecast. Weeks over your labor target are flagged.

What's included

  • Weekly schedule for up to 20 people, hours per day
  • Regular and overtime hours per person, at your threshold and multiplier
  • Loaded labor cost with your employer tax and insurance estimate
  • Labor % of forecast sales with an OVER TARGET flag
  • Staff hours per day to match the schedule to busy and quiet days
  • PDF guide with a worked example and a field-by-field reference

Who it's for

  • Restaurant, cafe and bar managers
  • Retail store managers
  • Clinic, salon and studio owners with hourly staff
  • Small teams with variable weekly hours

You get: shift_schedule_labor_cost_planner.xlsx (Settings, Schedule, Week Summary) and this guide.

Works in Excel 2016 or later, Excel for Mac and Excel on the web; opens in Google Sheets and LibreOffice.

This workbook is a planning tool, not legal or payroll advice. It applies weekly overtime after the threshold you set; some states also require daily overtime or other premiums, so check the rules that apply to your staff with your payroll provider.
